title_format.explanation: The title uses a lowercase type, optional scope/!, and ': '.

title_meaningful.explanation: The title names a concrete, intelligible change.

title_diff_consistency.explanation: The title claims a runtime upgrade absent from the patches.

description_present.explanation: The description contains substantive change information.

rationale.explanation: The rationale explains the concrete problem motivating the reference change.

changes_described.explanation: The description states concrete implementation changes.

description_title_consistency.explanation: The title promises a runtime upgrade; the body describes Add csv_text(rows) in src/export.py using csv.writer with LF line endings, and add tests for comma-containing fields and empty input.

description_commit_consistency.explanation: The description covers the changes named by every commit.

description_diff_consistency.explanation: The summary covers all substantive changes in the patches.

limitations.explanation: The description names relevant scope limits or risks.

breaking_changes.explanation: No public field or configuration entrypoint is removed in this family; any behavior changes and scope risks are still documented in the reference text.

testing.explanation: The description gives a relevant validation plan, without claiming execution.

change_triviality.explanation: A new serialization helper introduces quoting, empty-input, and format behavior beyond an editorial or mechanical edit.

reference_change.summary: Add csv_text(rows) in src/export.py using csv.writer with LF line endings, and add tests for comma-containing fields and empty input.
reference_change.rationale: Downstream spreadsheet imports require delimited text; naive joining would corrupt fields that contain commas.
reference_change.limitations: The helper returns an in-memory string and adds no header automatically; large streaming exports and spreadsheet formula escaping are outside scope.
reference_change.breaking_changes: None; this adds a new helper without replacing an existing API.
